decisions.reason: As a straightforward rye bread rooted in the bakery’s core production knowledge and still showing no negative signal, it remains easy to support and improve within existing capabilities.
The premium raisin stollen is a flagship product tightly aligned with established confectionery know-how and reinforced by the gold-medal quality signal, so withdrawal is very unlikely.
This rye mixed bread with seeds is a highly related extension of existing bread expertise, making continued retention the natural choice absent evidence of weak acceptance.
Marzipan Christmas stollen fits closely with the firm’s seasonal baking competence and complements the successful stollen range, though some seasonal assortment rationalisation risk remains.

Ancient grain bread is still the most exploratory item in the range, but after another period of learning it remains sufficiently close to the bakery’s bread-making knowledge to justify continuation rather than exit.
